channel.title: Status updates | Together AI
channel.description: Incidents and maintenance reported on status page for Together AI

item.title: Maintenance: Scheduled network maintenance
item.description:
We will be performing scheduled network maintenance on July 2nd, 9 PM – midnight.
During this window, some serverless models may experience degraded performance or be temporary unavailability. Check status.together.ai for per-model updates.
We appreciate your patience as we work through this. The goal remains the same — meaningfully more stable and performant models on the other side of this work.
